name: safectx
description: Create AI-safe copies before model use and restore private values locally afterward.

interface.shortDescription: Sanitize before AI, then restore locally.
interface.longDescription: SafeContext creates deterministic copies under .ai-safe, keeps the reversible mapping private, reports risk categories without printing detected values, and restores the AI result locally without returning private values to model context.
defaultPrompt: Make an AI-safe copy of these files before reading them.
Scan this workspace for secrets and create sanitized copies.
Restore the AI response locally without reading the private result.
